name: v120_call_put_breakeven_convexity_largecap
hypothesis: Long-vs-mid call/put breakeven convexity may capture option-demand asymmetry without using the occupied average breakeven/social sleeves.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.340 * group_rank(ts_rank(((call_breakeven_720 - put_breakeven_720) - (call_breakeven_90 - put_breakeven_90)) / close, 90), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(implied_volatility_call_360 - implied_volatility_put_360), 90), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry) + 0.140 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry), -1)

name: v120_forward_only_curvature_eventful
hypothesis: A pure forward-curve curvature signal, without social or breakeven confirmation, may be farther from GrwK89PO while preserving option-forward information.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) > 0.55, 0.360 * group_rank(ts_rank((forward_price_1080 + forward_price_60 - 2 * forward_price_270) / close, 90), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(implied_volatility_mean_360 - historical_volatility_180), 90), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry) + 0.140 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.120 * rank(cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative), -1)

name: v120_risk_volume_absorption_largecap
hypothesis: Stocks with weaker return-volume shock coupling and falling risk exposure may produce a technical/risk alpha less tied to news, social, option, or accounting parents.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.40, 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_corr(returns, volume / adv20, 20), 90), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(returns) * volume / adv20, 20), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_30_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_30_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry) + 0.100 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.060 * rank(cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative), -1)
